task.description:
Implement SCH-02 (Timer polling) per the design in src/design/scheduler.md.

Read the SCH-02 acceptance criteria and the scheduler module boundary in the design before writing code.

Implement the background scheduler poller so it:
- polls at a configurable interval (default 5 seconds)
- selects due timers with status = PENDING and fire_at <= NOW()
- acquires a PostgreSQL advisory lock per timer before firing
- marks the timer FIRED and appends the associated instance event in a single transaction
- skips timers whose lock is unavailable
- leaves timers PENDING if the firing transaction rolls back
- preserves SCH-03 compatibility so CANCELLED timers are never fired

Modify the relevant backend files under src/scheduler/ and any connected instance/event persistence code needed to complete the firing transaction. Add or update tests as needed.

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- zig build migrate exits 0
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler poller selects timers with status = PENDING and fire_at <= NOW()
Each due timer is processed in a single transaction that marks it FIRED and appends the instance event
A PostgreSQL advisory lock is acquired per timer and skipped if unavailable
Cancelled timers are never fired by SCH-02

result.summary: Implemented SCH-02 timer polling with due-timer selection, per-timer advisory lock claim, atomic FIRED + TIMER_FIRED persistence in one transaction, SKIP LOCKED behavior, and cancellation compatibility; fixed scheduler compile blockers and validated build/test/migrate.
